method_card.title: Holidays and Travel Plans
method_card.content:
This lesson covers holiday destinations, transport vocabulary, country prepositions and the near future tense for talking about travel plans.

FrenchEnglish
les vacancesholidays
au bord de la merat the seaside
à la montagnein the mountains
à la campagnein the countryside
à l'étrangerabroad
en avionby plane
en voitureby car
en trainby train
en bateauby boat
à véloby bike
à piedon foot
faire du tourismeto go sightseeing
bronzer sur la plageto sunbathe on the beach
rester dans un hôtelto stay in a hotel
(Higher) l'itinéraire (m)(Higher) itinerary

Country prepositions: Use en before feminine countries (en France, en Espagne, en Italie), au before masculine countries (au Portugal, au Canada, au Maroc), aux before plural countries (aux États-Unis), and à before cities (à Paris, à Rome). Note: le Mexique ends in -e but is masculine → au Mexique.

Near future tense (le futur proche): Use the present tense of aller + infinitive. Je vais, tu vas, il/elle/on va, nous allons, vous allez, ils/elles vont + infinitive. Example: L'été prochain, je vais aller en Espagne avec ma famille. (Next summer, I am going to go to Spain with my family.)

Model paragraph: Cette année, nous allons passer les vacances au bord de la mer en Italie. Nous allons voyager en train parce que c'est confortable. Je vais faire du tourisme et bronzer sur la plage. Ça va être fantastique! (This year, we are going to spend the holidays by the seaside in Italy. We are going to travel by train because it is comfortable. I am going to go sightseeing and sunbathe on the beach. It's going to be fantastic!)
steps: Learn the key holiday and destination vocabulary
Master country prepositions: en (feminine), au (masculine), aux (plural), à (cities)
Form the near future tense with aller + infinitive for all persons
Build full sentences combining destinations, transport and future plans

exam_context.frequency: Core topic — travel and holiday plans appear in every exam series

worked_examples.question: Translate to English: 'L'été prochain, nous allons aller en Italie en avion.'

steps.label: Step 1
steps.content: Break the sentence into chunks: L'été prochain | nous allons aller | en Italie | en avion.

steps.label: Step 2
steps.content: L'été prochain = Next summer. nous allons aller = we are going to go (near future: allons + aller).

steps.label: Step 3
steps.content: en Italie = to Italy (en because l'Italie is feminine). en avion = by plane.

steps.label: Answer
steps.content: Next summer, we are going to go to Italy by plane.

worked_examples.question: How do you choose the correct preposition before a country?

steps.label: Step 1
steps.content: Check the gender of the country. Most countries ending in -e are feminine: la France, l'Espagne, l'Italie.

steps.label: Step 2
steps.content: Feminine → en (en France). Masculine → au (au Canada, au Maroc). Plural → aux (aux États-Unis). Cities → à (à Paris).

steps.label: Step 3
steps.content: Watch the exception: le Mexique ends in -e but is masculine → au Mexique, not en Mexique.

steps.label: Answer
steps.content: Check gender: en (feminine), au (masculine), aux (plural), à (cities). Remember le Mexique is an exception.

worked_examples.question: Translate to French: 'Next year, I am going to travel to Canada by plane with my friends.'

steps.label: Step 1
steps.content: Identify the tense: 'am going to travel' = near future → je vais voyager.

steps.label: Step 2
steps.content: 'To Canada' — le Canada is masculine → au Canada. 'By plane' → en avion.

steps.label: Step 3
steps.content: 'Next year' = L'année prochaine. 'With my friends' = avec mes amis.

steps.label: Answer
steps.content: L'année prochaine, je vais voyager au Canada en avion avec mes amis.

bronze.question: Match the French holiday vocabulary to the English meaning
Match the French transport words to the English meaning
Complete the sentence with the correct form of aller

gaps.rule: Near future — je form of aller
gaps.correct_explain: vais is the je form of aller in the present tense, used to form the near future.

wrong.va: va is the il/elle/on form. The subject is je, so you need vais.
wrong.vas: vas is the tu form. The subject is je, so you need vais.

gaps.rule: Near future — elle form of aller
gaps.correct_explain: va is the il/elle form of aller. Ma sœur = elle.

wrong.vais: vais is the je form. Ma sœur = elle (singular), so you need va.
wrong.allons: allons is the nous form. Ma sœur = elle (singular), so you need va.

gaps.rule: Near future — nous form of aller

wrong.vont: vont is the ils/elles form. The subject is nous, so you need allons.
wrong.allez: allez is the vous form. The subject is nous, so you need allons.

bronze.question: Complete the sentences with the correct preposition for each country
sentence_parts: France avec ma famille. Mon ami va

gaps.correct_explain: en is used before feminine countries. La France is feminine.

wrong.au: au is for masculine countries. La France is feminine, so you need en.
wrong.aux: aux is for plural countries. La France is feminine singular, so you need en.

gaps.correct_explain: au is used before masculine countries. Le Maroc is masculine.

wrong.en: en is for feminine countries. Le Maroc is masculine, so you need au.
wrong.aux: aux is for plural countries. Le Maroc is masculine singular, so you need au.

gaps.correct_explain: aux is used before plural countries. Les États-Unis is plural.

wrong.au: au is for masculine singular countries. Les États-Unis is plural, so you need aux.
wrong.en: en is for feminine singular countries. Les États-Unis is plural, so you need aux.

bronze.question: What does 'Je vais aller à la montagne pour faire du ski' mean?
options: I am going to go to the mountains to go skiing
I went to the mountains to go skiing
I like going to the mountains to ski
I want to go to the mountains to go skiing

bronze.question: Which sentence correctly uses the near future to say 'They are going to travel by train'?

bronze.source_text: Nous allons passer les vacances au bord de la mer. On va nager et bronzer sur la plage.
model_answers: We are going to spend the holidays at the seaside. We are going to swim and sunbathe on the beach.
hints: passer les vacances = to spend the holidays
au bord de la mer = at the seaside

silver.question: Complete the sentence by typing the correct word
silver.english: Next summer, we are going to go abroad by plane.

gaps.rule: Near future — nous form of aller
gaps.correct_explain: allons is the nous form of aller, needed to form the near future tense.

wrong.vont: vont is the ils/elles form. The subject is nous, so you need allons.
wrong.allez: allez is the vous form. The subject is nous, so you need allons.

wrong.train: en train means by train, not by plane. You need avion.
wrong.voiture: en voiture means by car, not by plane. You need avion.

silver.question: Find and fix the grammatical error
silver.sentence: L'été prochain, je va aller en Espagne avec ma famille.
silver.explanation: The subject is je, so the form of aller must be vais, not va (which is the il/elle/on form).
silver.translation: Next summer, I am going to go to Spain with my family.

silver.question: Build the sentence in French
silver.english: We are going to travel by car to Italy.

distractor_labels.allez: wrong verb form — allez is the vous form, not nous

silver.source_text: Next year, I am going to go on holiday to Portugal with my family. We are going to stay at the seaside.
model_answers: L'année prochaine, je vais aller en vacances au Portugal avec ma famille. Nous allons rester au bord de la mer.

gold.source_text: Last year, I went to Spain by plane and next summer I am going to visit Italy with my friends because I love Italian food.
model_answers: L'année dernière, je suis allé(e) en Espagne en avion et l'été prochain je vais visiter l'Italie avec mes amis parce que j'adore la cuisine italienne.

gold.question: Build the sentence in French
gold.english: My parents are going to go to the United States by plane.

distractor_labels.au: wrong preposition — les États-Unis is plural, so you need aux not au
distractor_labels.va: wrong verb form — va is il/elle/on, but mes parents = ils, so you need vont
distractor_labels.allons: wrong verb form — allons is nous, but mes parents = ils, so you need vont

gold.question: Role Play
gold.scenario: You are at a tourist information office in France and want to plan a visit. The assistant helps you with holiday ideas.

bullets.prompt: Say where you are going to go on holiday and who with.
bullets.model_answer: Je vais aller au bord de la mer en Bretagne avec ma famille.
bullets.note: near future (je vais aller) + destination + avec + companion

bullets.prompt: Say how you are going to travel and why.
bullets.model_answer: Nous allons voyager en train parce que c'est moins cher que l'avion.
bullets.note: near future (nous allons voyager) + transport + parce que + comparative

bullets.prompt: Ask what activities you can do there.
bullets.model_answer: Qu'est-ce qu'on peut faire au bord de la mer?
bullets.note: Qu'est-ce qu'on peut faire — polite question form using pouvoir

bullets.prompt: Say what you are going to do on holiday and give your opinion.
bullets.model_answer: Je vais nager dans la mer et visiter des monuments. Ça va être super!
bullets.note: near future (je vais nager / visiter) + opinion (ça va être super)

gold.audio_text: L'été prochain, je vais aller en Espagne avec ma famille et nous allons rester au bord de la mer.
gold.correct_text: L'été prochain, je vais aller en Espagne avec ma famille et nous allons rester au bord de la mer.
